objective.text: DAFT / DAFT-2 tests that a modified P-Trak particulate counter would be accurate in microgravity.
objective.quote: DAFT / DAFT-2 tests that a modified P-Trak particulate counter would be accurate in microgravity.

measurements.text: The modified P-Trak gathered data from counting aerosol particles and these data were compared to the DustTrak CNC specifically designed to work in microgravity.
measurements.quote: The modified P-Trak gathered data from counting aerosol particles and these data were compared to the DustTrak CNC specifically designed to work in microgravity.

safety_finding.text: This research will impact the development of novel fire and smoke detection systems for the International Space Station and future spacecrafts.
safety_finding.quote: This research will impact the development of novel fire and smoke detection systems for the International Space Station and future spacecrafts.

earth_benefits.text: Additionally, the successful adaptation of the TSI P-Trak for microgravity can inform the design of instruments for use in other challenging Earth environments, such as submarines or underwater laboratories where accurate detection of smoke can save lives.
